items.name: Matchbox
items.description: A tin box of sulfur matches. Striking one relights your wick, but the sulfur reek alerts the Shadow.

items.name: Rusty Cleaver
items.description: Heavy butcher iron crusted in dried gore. Lethal against beasts, but carrying it drains composure constantly.

items.name: The Book
items.description: A massive volume bound in black hide. Contains forbidden truths, but reading it is agonizingly slow and watched.

items.name: Silver Whistle
items.description: Tarnished silver engraved with warding runes. Its shrill blast subdues the Hell Dog, but echoes to worse things.

items.name: Dog's Tooth
items.description: A jagged canine tooth torn from the beast. Useless for defense; its bitter stench is only grim proof of survival.

items.name: Front Door Key
items.description: Cold wrought iron that fits the manor exit. Freedom's price, though two of its three paths lead to death.

rooms.name: The Hall
rooms.prose:
A high, vaulted manor hall. The air is cold and smells of damp stone and tallow.
To the left, an open archway breathes a faint, warm stench of raw iron.
To the right, a heavy carved door stands ajar toward quiet dust.
Ahead, a wide staircase ascends into suffocating, unlit darkness.
Behind you, the massive front door is swollen shut in its heavy iron frame.
rooms.revisit_prose:
You step back into the vaulted silence of the hall. The dust motes hang undisturbed.
Now that you have studied the lectern's tome, the front door is no longer an impassable slab — you recognize the concealed latch along its iron frame.

choices.label: Work the concealed latch on the front door
Attempt to climb the dark grand staircase
Take the right-hand passage into the library
Step through the left archway into the gloom
choices.cause: You stepped blindly past the warned threshold and were butchered in the dark.
telegraphs: A draft of warm, unnatural air breathes steadily from the dark archway.
A wet, rhythmic dripping echoes somewhere just past the threshold, accompanied by the dull scrape of bone on stone.

choices.label: Take the matchbox resting on the cold mantel
telegraphs: A faint metallic clink comes from the fireplace ledge.

choices.label: Let your trembling hands drop and step willingly into the gathering dark
Carefully navigate the warm archway into the blood kitchen
Unbolt the back threshold door leading into the rainy yard
Reach into the ticking grandfather clock housing for the brass key
choices.cause: You reached into the clock cabinet; a heavy lead counterweight plummeted, crushing your arm and alerting the dark.
telegraphs: The grandfather clock's pendulum ticks with a harsh, erratic shudder, strung on coiled steel.
A pungent smell of hot gear oil and shaved brass drifts from inside the narrow wooden housing.

choices.label: Slam the heavy front door shut as burning fangs snap outside in the fog
telegraphs: Ember-red eyes blaze through the entryway fog — the banished hound has tracked you to the exit!

choices.label: Turn away from the night air and bolt the door from the inside
Extinguish the flame and step into the silent dark

rooms.name: Old Library
rooms.prose:
Rows of towering oak shelves lean inward like tired sentinels, bowing under rotting leather and mold.
The air is dead-still and freezing, thick with the scent of powdered parchment and ancient tallow.
In the center of the chamber, a heavy iron lectern bears an enormous open tome.
Its yellowed vellum pages lie bathed in the shivering beam of your lantern.
Every shadow between the bookcases feels deliberate, as though the room itself were holding its breath, watching you turn each page.

choices.label: Read the open tome on the lectern
Return to the hall
Search the darkened alcove behind the shelves
choices.expiry_text: The alcove has filled with heavy shadows; you hesitated too long.
telegraphs: Dust settles quickly in the alcove; the space will soon be swallowed by darkness.

choices.label: Study the heavy leather-bound Book across three consecutive turns
Continue reading the yellowed passage by guttering candle
Step away from the lectern and watch the silent room
Inspect the secret drawer beneath the study desk

rooms.name: The Threshold of Blood
rooms.prose:
You cross into the suffocating dark of the unlit passage. Before your eyes can adjust, a silhouette lunges with jagged butcher's iron.
There is no time to raise the lantern, and no second step.
rooms.cause: You stepped blindly past the warned threshold and were butchered in the dark.

rooms.name: The Threshold of Night
rooms.prose:
The concealed iron release clicks beneath the frame. The massive oak door gives way with a groan of cold hinges.
You slip outside into the biting night fog, the manor's shadow receding behind you.
The lantern wick gutters in the mountain wind, but you are out. You survived.

rooms.name: The Dark Embrace
rooms.prose:
Your trembling hands go still. The hammering in your chest slows to a quiet, cold rhythm.
You stop running. You stop looking for doors that only open inward.
From the high corners of the ceiling, the shadows lower themselves like black silk.
"There now," the Shadow murmurs, its voice right against your ear, familiar as your own thought.
"Was that so hard? You fought so loudly for so small a scrap of tallow."
You do not close your eyes. You step forward into the cold, painless dark, and let the house take you.

rooms.name: Stay
rooms.prose: The night outside is vast, cold, and empty. You reach out and pull the iron door shut from the inside. The lock clicks. You are home.

rooms.name: The Long Walk
rooms.prose: You fell where you first stood. The darkness steps over you gently. It does not gloat. You were brave enough to open your eyes.

rooms.name: Blood Kitchen
rooms.prose:
An oppressive heat radiates from an iron woodstove. The air is heavy with grease and copper.
A massive cleaver stands buried deep in an oak chopping block, its blade crusted with dark crimson.
Hanging from cold ceiling hooks are wrapped cuts of butcher meat, dripping slowly into zinc pans.
On a high shelf behind a looming pig carcass rests a battered tin flask of lantern oil.
At the center table, an enameled basin holds a tarnished brass key resting atop a tangle of warm entrails.

choices.label: Pry the heavy rusty cleaver out of the oak block
Cut down a slab of raw meat from the ceiling hook
Reach behind the hanging carcass to refill your lantern from the tin canister
telegraphs: The cold carcass sways slightly on its chain as your shoulder brushes past.

choices.label: Reach barehanded into the basin of warm entrails for the key
choices.cause: You plunged your hand into the viscera; barbed iron teeth sprang shut from the mire, severing your wrist.
telegraphs: Unnatural, feverish steam rises steadily from the gore in the basin.
A rhythmic, sickening pulse thrums under the basin rim, as if the entrails were coiled around a hair-trigger spring.

choices.label: Retreat through the archway back into The Hall

rooms.name: The Butcher's Grip
rooms.prose:
Barbed iron jaws snap shut out of the warm offal with bone-crushing force.
The dark rushes in before you can cry out.
rooms.cause: You plunged your hand into the viscera; barbed iron teeth sprang shut from the mire, severing your wrist.

rooms.name: The Clockwork Guillotine
rooms.prose: A sudden metallic snap rings out. The lead counterweight drops like an executioner's blade, pinning you in the dark.
rooms.cause: You reached into the clock cabinet; a heavy lead counterweight plummeted, crushing your arm and alerting the dark.

rooms.name: Old Yard
rooms.prose:
Cold driving rain lashes down from a starless sky, turning the cobblestones into slick black mud.
To the north and east, an immense stone perimeter wall rises ten cubits high, slick with wet moss and completely insurmountable.
Near the muddy garden beds stands a low, rotting wooden doghouse. Heavy iron chain links lie coiled in the mud.
Near the shed steps, something metallic glints faintly beneath fallen pine needles.
There is no way over the wall; the only path is back through the manor door.

choices.label: Kneel in the mud and pick up the tarnished silver whistle
Attempt to scale the dripping stone perimeter wall
telegraphs: The stone blocks are worn smooth by decades of rain, offering no handhold or ledge.

choices.label: Approach the dark opening of the chained doghouse
telegraphs: A deep, guttural growl vibrates through the wet earth beneath your boots.

choices.label: Step out of the drenching rain back into The Hall

rooms.name: The Kennel
rooms.prose:
Two ember-red eyes open in the pitch blackness of the rotting kennel.
The Hell Dog rises slowly, ribs like iron slats under soot-black hide. Twin jaws part to exhale hot ash.
It does not lunge — it stands perfectly still, waiting. It only moves when you move.

choices.label: Freeze and stand perfectly still in the rain
telegraphs: The beast pauses, black chest heaving. It does not advance. It is waiting for you to move.

choices.label: Edge past slowly, step by deliberate step
Sprint for the courtyard gate
Toss the butcher's meat across the wet stones
Blow the silver whistle sounding the true name from the tome
Blow the silver whistle with an ignorant, shrill blast
telegraphs: The piercing shriek echoes off the stone walls, but the hound merely bares its fangs in heightened fury.

choices.label: Step backward very slowly toward the courtyard

endings.title: The Long Walk
endings.name: The Long Walk
endings.tone: Failure, but the shadow respects you
endings.summary: You perished at the very threshold of the house.
endings.prose: You fell where you first stood. The darkness steps over you gently. It does not gloat. You were brave enough to open your eyes.

endings.title: Meat and Silence
endings.name: Meat and Silence
endings.summary: You fed the Hell Dog and slipped past in the grease and quiet.
endings.prose: The cold bone grease coats your palms. Behind you, wet mastication fills the yard. You survived, but the sound will never leave your ears.

endings.title: The Quiet Exit
endings.name: The Quiet Exit
endings.summary: You unlatched the heavy front door and stepped out into the night.
endings.prose: The iron key turns with a dry snap. The night air hits your lungs like ice. You walk down the gravel drive and do not look back. You survived.

endings.title: What the Book Knew
endings.name: What the Book Knew
endings.summary: You read the forbidden tome to completion and escaped with its truths.
endings.prose: The lock yields to your whispered word. The house cannot hold what has read its marrow. You step out under stars you finally understand.

endings.title: The New Shadow
endings.name: The New Shadow
endings.tone: You got out. Something came with you.
endings.summary: You escaped in pitch darkness. You did not leave alone.
endings.prose: The door opened into total blackness. You ran until your feet hit grass. The lantern was dead. You cast two shadows in the moonlight.

endings.title: Homecoming
endings.name: Homecoming
endings.summary: The three memory fragments revealed what the manor truly was: your home.
endings.prose: The photograph. The child's hand. The date stamped tomorrow. This was never a prison; it was a home you abandoned. The front door dissolves into dawn.

endings.title: Stay
endings.name: Stay
endings.summary: You stood before the open night, turned around, and closed the door.
endings.prose: The night outside is vast, cold, and empty. You reach out and pull the iron door shut from the inside. The lock clicks. You are home.
